exposure: latent OGTT patterns (high, medium, and low glucose levels)
finding: Three distinct OGTT patterns (high, medium, and low glucose levels) were identified, with the high glucose (HG) pattern showing a five-fold higher risk of late-onset GDM and increased likelihood of adverse perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Participants in the high glucose (HG) pattern were more likely to have cesarean deliveries (RR: 1.15, 95% CI: 1.08-1.23).
